name: Transport terminal
provenance: AI-authored synthetic recorded starting layout for a doors/windows benchmark; not customer data, not a certified design.
start_state: Whole-building recorded BIM layout; zero starting openings; reserved vertical cores
grading: Scored by the reviewer. There is no exact answer key.
limitations: Supplemental synthetic benchmark coverage only, not selected production-run cases or evidence of a production result.
Metre coordinates describe disjoint clear-space boxes, not walls. No doors or windows are seeded. Empty areas are unassigned shell, exterior, courtyard, or the explicitly described void.
Exactly two stair footprints and two lift footprints are vertically stacked reservations on every floor. They are not physical stairs, lifts, shafts, or installed equipment.

Public, controlled and service labels and circulation zones express intended thresholds. Access edges are reciprocal same-floor adjacency intentions, not installed doors or an enforced security policy.

No structural, fire, accessibility, egress, acoustic, laboratory safety, sporting-body, or transport-operational compliance is asserted. Reservations do not model inter-floor travel or exit discharge.

Terminal landside building only: no track, platform, aircraft, bus bay or vehicle interface is modeled. Central ground concourse is 40 by 24 m and 15 m high, equal to the sum of three 5 m floors. Its entire footprint is omitted on both upper floors, including the 6 m deep north service strip boundary; upper amenity and operations galleries occupy perimeter wings only. The ground-floor entrance lift lobby on the south facade is the main passenger entrance; the east staff wing is 10 m deep.
